cases.title: Repository and baseline reconciliation
cases.expected: Live repository/default branch/HEAD, tags and releases are inspected; newer work is preserved; wrong repository or conflicting v1.0.0 blocks writes.

cases.title: Safe bundle import and helper review
cases.method: isolated importer tests, both Windows shells
cases.expected: Preview has zero writes; apply creates only new allowlisted planning files; identical files are skipped; conflicts, symlink targets and wrong checkout are refused.

cases.title: Live synchronization check
cases.method: isolated helper tests plus actual live read
cases.expected: Clean matching branch passes; dirty, detached, mismatched, absent remote ref or network failure cannot pass; fetch and push destinations are both verified.

cases.title: Baseline formats and codec behavior
cases.expected: MP3, M4A, Ogg Vorbis and Ogg Opus including uppercase .OGG reproduce current intended behavior with generated fixtures; unsupported extensions remain excluded.

cases.title: Default audio and naming contract
cases.expected: Record actual 64 kbps CBR, ID3v2.3, channels/sample rate, default MaxBaseLength 60, recursive layout, dates, title and override behavior; no unapproved DSP change.

cases.title: Source safety baseline
cases.expected: Input file bytes and relative names remain identical before/after conversion; generated fixtures are the only disposable media.

cases.title: Output override and isolation
cases.expected: OutputParent directs runs only beneath the chosen test parent; ordinary automated tests never write into the real Music library.

cases.title: Music default resolution
cases.method: resolver unit test plus owner-safe smoke
cases.expected: Default uses the configured Windows Music folder, including injected redirected-path resolver tests; a narrowly controlled manual/default test removes only its own run.

cases.title: Input and parameter validation
cases.expected: Missing, non-directory, non-filesystem and malformed inputs; unsupported bitrate; too-small/large MaxBaseLength fail clearly before conversion or optional prompts.

cases.title: Root, permissions and disk handling
cases.method: negative fixtures and Windows permissions test
cases.expected: Drive/share roots are correctly rejected or explicitly supported under the recorded contract; unreadable input and unwritable output fail safely; no registry/security changes.

cases.title: Incremental extraction
cases.expected: Public entry points and established parameters/defaults remain; helpers can be tested without prompting or starting a conversion; no new runtime language/framework.

cases.title: Native arguments and process errors
cases.method: argv capture stub plus FFmpeg tests
cases.expected: Space/bracket/apostrophe/ampersand/quote/Unicode arguments reach the executable intact on PS 5.1 and PS 7; no shell evaluation; immediate exit status retained.

cases.title: Process I/O does not deadlock
cases.expected: Simultaneously drain stdout/stderr under stress, bound retained diagnostics, use -nostdin, release process resources and do not treat ordinary native stderr as automatic failure.

cases.title: Probe and dependency results are explicit
cases.expected: Missing/non-executable/unsupported tools, missing libmp3lame, nonzero ffprobe, invalid JSON, no audio and missing title are distinct; absolute tool path/version logged.

cases.title: Generated output exclusion
cases.expected: Choosing Music or another ancestor does not rescan current or recognized legacy/new output; an unrelated similarly named user folder is not silently discarded.

cases.title: Reparse points and inaccessible subtrees
cases.expected: Directory reparse points are skipped and reported; access failure follows abort-before-convert contract; no loops, out-of-tree traversal or hidden partial scan.

cases.title: Input/output boundary
cases.method: path comparison unit and integration tests
cases.expected: Canonical, separator-aware containment checks handle casing and similarly prefixed directories; unsafe destinations/overlap are rejected without changing sources.

cases.title: Valid and invalid dates
cases.expected: Real YYYY-MM-DD prefix retained; impossible dates fall back to LastWriteTime with a defined title rule; locale does not change the result.

cases.title: Unicode and literal filenames
cases.expected: NFC/decomposed accents, Finnish/German letters, punctuation and whitespace normalize predictably; literal-path operations do not interpret brackets as wildcards.

cases.title: Deterministic collision allocation
cases.expected: Stable ordinal ordering produces a repeatable source-to-output mapping even with mixed extensions, case collisions and duplicate sanitized names.

cases.title: Complete filename and path limits
cases.method: boundary unit and Windows path tests
cases.expected: Date prefix, basename, suffix and extension budgets are enforced; long directories are rejected clearly rather than source-renamed; surrogate pairs are not split.

cases.title: Concurrent run reservation
cases.expected: Two synchronized launches obtain different exclusively owned roots and logs; no timing sleep or check-then-create race is used as correctness proof.

cases.title: No overwrite of an existing run
cases.expected: Pre-existing directories/logs/sentinel files remain byte-identical; ownership marker is exclusive and cleanup knows only this run.

cases.title: Transactional success
cases.method: real conversion plus staged fault injection
cases.expected: A final .mp3 appears only after a nonempty working file has valid expected audio, plausible duration and a no-overwrite final promotion.

cases.title: False successes rejected
cases.method: stub process plus output probe fixtures
cases.expected: Zero exit with empty/corrupt/non-audio/truncated/implausibly long output is failure; container bitrate including cover is not mistaken for audio bitrate.

cases.title: Failure cleanup and destination races
cases.expected: Nonzero encoder/probe/rename errors cannot leave a final-looking partial or overwrite a concurrent final file; only current owned temporary files are removed.

cases.title: Partial-batch exit contract
cases.expected: Good+bad inputs continue per contract, record both outcomes and return nonzero; successful conversions return zero; preflight/no-supported-files remain nonzero.

cases.title: BAT result and argument contract
cases.expected: BAT captures and returns child code even after pause; not always Done; zero/multiple dropped folders rejected clearly; tricky Windows paths do not expand unexpectedly.

cases.title: Controlled cancellation
cases.method: manual Ctrl+C plus controlled process test
cases.expected: Cancel stops only this owned process, waits for its exit, marks run cancelled, retains completed outputs and removes current partial; unrelated FFmpeg survives.

cases.title: Crash leftovers and cleanup boundaries
cases.expected: Forced termination leftovers are recognizable incomplete files; next run neither treats them as audio nor deletes arbitrary paths/other live runs; limits are documented.

cases.title: No-write preview
cases.expected: Preview creates no directories, marker, cover cache, log, manifest or audio and launches no encoder; interactive choices do not appear; omitted writability checks are explicit.

cases.title: Preview accuracy
cases.expected: For unchanged inputs/options, preview and real run share the same naming/collision planner; provisional run-root timestamp/reservation and unknown durations are labelled.

cases.title: Honest progress
cases.method: record-stream unit tests and long-file smoke
cases.expected: Batch/file progress uses machine-readable records; final success is not shown before output validation/promotion; failures remain visible at 100 percent processed.

cases.title: Unknown duration and long times
cases.expected: Unknown duration gives indeterminate status; HH beyond one hour parses correctly; malformed progress does not crash conversion or invent ETA.

cases.title: Diagnostics persist locally
cases.expected: Useful native error details survive in the run log with tool/app versions, timings and final outcome; large native output is bounded; logs are not uploaded.

cases.title: Manifest correctness
cases.expected: One row per discovered candidate outcome; Unicode, commas, newlines and formula-like text safely represented; input/output paths, duration, bytes and failure reasons are traceable.

cases.title: Accurate outcome totals
cases.expected: Discovered/converted/failed/skipped/cancelled counts reconcile; actual bytes and elapsed time are reported; scan exclusions are distinguishable from successful conversions.

cases.title: Metadata precedence
cases.expected: Existing/fallback title, Ogg stream metadata, track/disc, quoted/non-ASCII artist/album and explicit overrides have deterministic precedence on both shells.

cases.title: Artwork default and explicit replacement
cases.expected: Source artwork absent by preserved default; supplied valid cover embedded exactly once; a missing/corrupt/undecodable explicit cover fails preflight, not silent success.

cases.title: Cover handling and chapter honesty
cases.method: resource test and chapter fixture/manual documentation
cases.expected: Validate supplied cover once per run and dispose handles; avoid unexpected resizing; document/test actual chapter behavior without promising phone chapter navigation.

cases.title: Regression/failure suite remains meaningful
cases.expected: Existing integration coverage preserved or explicitly mapped to replacement assertions; failure/edge/concurrency cases pass on both Windows shells.

cases.title: Test cleanup is contained
cases.method: cleanup negative tests and hash inventory
cases.expected: Fixtures/results live in owned temporary trees; cleanup refuses reparse/outside/pre-existing paths; production sources and unrelated files remain unchanged.

cases.title: CI matches supported shells
cases.expected: Windows jobs run syntax, analysis, focused tests and real-FFmpeg integration in powershell and pwsh; dependency availability is verified, not assumed.

cases.title: CI supply-chain controls
cases.expected: Reviewed full action SHAs, minimal read permissions for tests, pinned verified dependency source/digest and no secret-bearing untrusted PR execution.

cases.title: Help and examples work
cases.expected: Get-Help recognizes comment-based help; examples parse and run; unsupported inputs, normalization limits, exits and cancellation are documented correctly.

cases.title: Single version and support claims
cases.expected: One authoritative 1.0.0 version drives banner/help/package; docs list actual tested OS/shell/device boundaries, unsigned status and external dependencies.

cases.title: Explicit distributable allowlist
cases.expected: Package includes required entry points/helpers/docs/license, excludes personal media/logs, build junk and unnecessary poster; no FFmpeg binaries accidentally bundled.

cases.title: Dependency and repository hygiene
cases.expected: Runtime remains local, no telemetry/downloader; resolved tool identity reported; tracked-change scan finds no credentials or private paths/media; licensing notices accurate.

cases.title: Windows 11 acceptance
cases.method: named actual BAT/PS5.1 STA observations plus automated both-shell real Windows checks; explicitly revised at Janne Vuorela repeated request on 2026-10-11; current PS7 picker, physical Cancel/hardware Ctrl+C/fallback not observed
cases.expected: Real Windows 11 runs with PS5.1 and PS7 cover BAT drag/drop, metadata interaction, spaces/special characters, cancellation and failure result; record exact environment.

cases.title: Windows long-file and default-path smoke
cases.method: owner-selected representative media with automated quantitative checks and controlled default-Music smoke; revised at Janne Vuorela request on 2026-10-11
cases.expected: Representative long audio completes with correct duration and resource behavior; controlled default Music destination works; managed-policy restrictions are not bypassed.

cases.title: Phone long-file playback and seeking
cases.expected: Record phone/OS/player version, transfer method and exact tested asset/source; beginning/middle/near-end playback and seeking work on representative long audio.

cases.title: Phone tags, artwork and ordering
cases.expected: Check title, Artist/Album, cover and track ordering; compare documented chapter limitations and resume behavior; failures are not labelled universal phone compatibility.

cases.title: Required review outcomes are closed
cases.expected: Improvements 1–15 map to passing evidence, known limits are explicit and no blocking defects remain; O01 stays deferred unless specifically activated.

cases.title: Main integration is reviewed and synchronized
cases.expected: Approved in-scope PRs integrated without bypass; clean local main equals live main; no unmerged runtime/test/build changes remain.

cases.title: Exact frozen commit and ZIP
cases.method: exact-commit clean worktree and ZIP test
cases.expected: Freeze C only after final version/code/docs/CI are committed; build ZIP from clean C via deterministic allowlist; extracted ZIP passes shell/FFmpeg/launcher smoke.

cases.title: Candidate provenance is self-consistent
cases.expected: Record C, ZIP digest, dependency/test versions, signing status and per-member hashes in external release-manifest; no self-hashing manifest or stale working-tree files.

cases.title: Exact release authority and immutable tag
cases.expected: Recorded approval matches C and exact ZIP/manifest digests; no conflicting tag/release; annotated v1.0.0 remotely resolves to C; no forced retarget.

cases.title: Draft is not completion
cases.expected: Draft points at verified existing tag; only expected assets uploaded; state remains incomplete; missing asset/upload or failed check blocks publication.

cases.title: Uploaded draft bytes verified
cases.expected: Download each draft asset into fresh temp through authenticated release read; names, sizes and SHA-256 match candidate; extracted uploaded ZIP smoke passes.

cases.title: Normal public release exists
cases.expected: v1.0.0 is public, published, non-draft and non-prerelease; repository visibility is public; no intermediate public releases were introduced.

cases.title: Public downloads match candidate
cases.expected: Anonymous downloads of ZIP, external manifest and SHA256SUMS succeed; digests and every ZIP member match reviewed evidence and safe allowlist.

cases.title: Actually released ZIP works
cases.expected: Extract newly downloaded public ZIP into a clean Windows location and run required smoke; record downloaded hash, shell version, command and actual result.

cases.title: Final source/tag relationship
cases.method: full commit diff and ancestry check
cases.expected: C remains tag target; final main D contains only docs/codex-v1 progress/evidence additions beyond C; all shipped/runtime/test/build/CI files remain unchanged.

cases.title: Final synchronization and closure
cases.expected: Required task/case evidence is pushed; local main is clean and equals live main; public verification still passes; final response reports real URL/tag/C/hashes/D.

cases.title: No fabricated completion
cases.expected: Missing authorization, manual test, remote access, asset or CI remains blocker; no required case is silently waived and no template is counted as a result.

cases.title: Optional loudness mode is opt-in
cases.method: optional regression and measured audio tests
cases.expected: Default FFmpeg arguments/output behavior have no loudness filter; enabled mode uses a tested measured pipeline with documented target, channel/rate policy and fallback.

cases.title: Loudness edge cases and output measurements
cases.expected: Silence, short clips, invalid measurements and dynamic fallback handled explicitly; decoded final MP3 loudness/peaks within documented tolerance; log actual mode.
